DUBLIN--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- The "Industrial Enzymes - Global Strategic Business Report" report has been added to ResearchAndMarkets.com's offering.

 Global Industrial Enzymes Market to Reach $8.2 Billion by 2030 

 The global market for Industrial Enzymes estimated at US$6.1 Billion in the year 2023, is projected to reach a revised size of US$8.2 Billion by 2030, growing at a CAGR of 4.4% over the analysis period 2023-2030. 

 Industrial enzymes, known as eco-friendly catalysts, play a crucial role in enhancing the efficiency and speed of industrial processes. The global industrial enzymes market is characterized by several key trends and recent activities that highlight its dynamic nature. One of the primary drivers for market growth is the increasing need to replace harsh chemical processes with environmentally friendly enzymatic processes. Enzymes offer significant advantages over chemical catalysts, including safer workplaces by eliminating harsh chemical treatments, energy conservation, and reduced toxicity of effluents during wastewater treatment. 

 Carbohydrases, one of the segments analyzed in the report, is expected to record a 4.3% CAGR and reach US$3.6 Billion by the end of the analysis period. Growth in the Proteases segment is estimated at 4.8% CAGR for the next 7-year period. 

 The surging demand for eco-friendly enzymes is spurring research and development, leading to advancements in biotechnology that further enhance enzyme performance. This demand drives widespread adoption across various end-use industries, including food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, biofuels, and wastewater treatment, to name a few. The market fortunes of industrial enzymes are closely tied to the overall performance of the enzymes market, with biotechnology providing solutions in an increasingly enzyme-dependent world. 

 The global market outlook for industrial enzymes is positive, with projections indicating significant market shares held by key competitors by 2024. Continuous advancements in biotechnology and the growing emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly industrial processes are expected to further propel market growth. 

 U.S. Market is Estimated at $1.6 Billion, While China is Forecast to Grow at 7.3% CAGR 

 The Industrial Enzymes market in the U.S. is estimated at US$1.6 Billion in the year 2023. China, the world's second largest economy, is forecast to reach a projected market size of US$1.7 Billion by the year 2030 trailing a CAGR of 7.3% over the analysis period 2023 to 2030. Among the other noteworthy geographic markets are Japan and Canada, each forecast to grow at 2.3% and 3.6% respectively over the 2023-2030 period. 

 Within Europe, Germany is forecast to grow at approximately 2.9% CAGR. Led by countries such as Australia, India, and South Korea, the market in Asia-Pacific is forecast to reach US$1.1 Billion by the year 2030.
